markers.description: General compiler note (used for etymology/borrowing notes)

rules: Homonyms: Formatted as separate entries with a number (e.g., 'dae 1.', 'dae 2.'); requires separate \lx blocks with \hm 1, 2, etc.
Subentries: Placed under a main entry (often introduced by 'in:' or indentation), using \se followed by \ge.
Cross-references: Printed in parentheses at the end of the gloss block (e.g., '(cf. baeho)'), tracked via \cf.
Compiler Notes: Parenthetical comments on separate lines like '(presumably borrowed)' are captured in \nt.
Local French Names: Printed in quotation marks after the English gloss; typically captured within \ge or a secondary \ge field.
